title.description: Name of the website/resource collection (should reflect the specific focus/purpose of this site)

version.description: Schema version of the links data following semantic versioning (MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH)

last_updated.description: Timestamp indicating when the links data was last modified (ISO 8601 format)

id.description: Unique identifier for the link entry (lowercase alphanumeric characters and hyphens only)

title.description: Name of the resource/service as it should appear on this site (must be context-specific, not generic)

summary.description: Brief overview of what the resource offers (must be tailored to this site's audience and purpose, avoid generic descriptions)

description.description: Detailed explanation of the resource and its relevance to this site's specific audience/purpose (should explain what this resource offers to the intended audience)

url.description: Direct URL to the resource (must be a valid, accessible link)

image.description: URL to logo, screenshot, or visual representation of the resource (optional)

category.description: Broad classification grouping similar resources (should align with site's taxonomy)

tags.description: Array of specific keywords for finer-grained classification (must reflect site-specific taxonomy, not generic tags)

created_at.description: Timestamp when this link entry was first added to the collection (ISO 8601 format)

updated_at.description: Timestamp when this link entry was last modified (ISO 8601 format)

featured.description: Boolean indicating whether this resource should be highlighted/promoted on the site (default: false)

status.description: Current validity/availability status of the resource (options: active, archived, broken)

pricing.description: Cost model for accessing the resource (options: free, freemium, paid, unknown)

language.description: Primary language of the resource content (ISO 639-1 two-letter code, default: en)
